reasons: Sections 18.1–18.2 satisfy every element of the preferred position: CGL USD 1M/2M, workers' compensation as required by law, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, term plus one year, and certificates of insurance on request.
No redline or comment is proposed, which is the expected treatment for a compliant finding; the deterministic check confirms an insurance obligation is present.
Obligations run against Vendor (as defined) and benefit Customer, so no directional issue; extra employer's liability coverage is additive and not adverse.
